title: Average cost under coordinate permutations
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates with outputs in $\alpha$. For every permutation of the coordinates, the average number of queries of the permuted tree under independent inputs distributed according to $\pi$ is equal to that of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The input coordinates are independently distributed according to the same probability distribution $\pi$ on $\Omega$
$T$ is a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates
A permutation of the $n$ coordinates is chosen
